results.title: Trasadi
results.overview: Darpan Maskey, 20s, is haunted by someone performing a weird ritual. Severe hand wounds and whispers haunt Darpan as he slowly begins to realize the predicament he is in. To get out of this situation, he takes the help of his friend, Kiran, a young priest who desires to help out his friend and to stand up on his own feet, independent of his father. He takes Darpan and tries to help him in his own way, as Darpan has to make tough decisions. This leads to a situation both of them could never have predicted.

results.title: Knar
results.overview: In a quiet village, the body of an elderly man, Bhimsen Chhetri, is prepared for his final rites. His legs are carefully tied, his body bound with ritual precision, and the mourners stand in silence as tradition is followed without question. As the funeral procession begins, the film shifts decades into the past. A younger Bhimsen helps carry the body of his friend named Balmiki along with one old man and another young man through mustard fields toward the riverside for cremation. During a brief rest, a young man and an old man went to collect the wood into the jungle leaving Bhimsen alone with the corpse. What follows is an unexplainable event.

results.title: Egg
results.overview: Mahiro (32), anxious about losing her eggs, forms relationships with the men in her share house through egg dishes. But as she becomes aware of their strange dreams and her own growing obsession, she begins to confront herself.

results.title: Jangan Dicium
results.overview: After a long-term relationship, Jali risks losing his chance to marry Ainun—all because his body odor is potent enough to knock out his prospective in-laws. Now, Jali is in a race against time to find a way to smell fresh before Ainun is married off to someone else. Can Jali save his romance, or will his body odor end up being his final "partner"?
